intro: AskWRI has no accounts and does not know who you are. This page lists what the system keeps, where, and for how long.

items.data: The text of your question (Demand Radar log)
items.kept: Every question that is not blocked by the safety filter, whether or not it was answered. Stored with the time, guessed language, an optional team label, whether it was answered, the search score and the cited titles. Emails and phone numbers are replaced by [email] and [phone]. Up to 1,000 characters. Deleted after RADAR_RETENTION_DAYS (default 90); cleanup runs when a new question is logged.

items.data: Questions blocked by the safety filter
items.kept: Not kept, because a blocked question may contain a card number or a secret

items.data: Email addresses, phone numbers and IP addresses typed into a question
items.where: Masked by the safety filter before search and the AI see them, for example {EMAIL}
items.kept: Masked version only (for example {EMAIL}) when the safety filter is configured, which this page's live status shows. Emails and phone numbers are additionally replaced by [email] and [phone] before the Radar stores them.

items.data: Card numbers, SSNs, passwords, AWS keys typed into a question
items.where: Globe app: request is blocked and never logged. Agents app: no safety filter (see last row).
items.status: verified for the globe app only

items.data: Names and place names typed into a question
items.where: NOT masked, because masking them would break research questions
items.kept: Stored with the question text above

items.data: The optional team label you type
items.kept: Stored exactly as typed, up to 60 characters, and not scrubbed. Do not put a personal name or email here.

items.data: What your questions reveal about your research
items.kept: Do not include confidential project details in a question

items.data: Your question while it is being answered
items.where: Amazon Bedrock (safety check and AI model)
items.kept: AskWRI code does not store model prompts. Bedrock model-call logging appears off in the team test account; the production account is to be confirmed.

items.where: Web server console log (the server prints the client address per request)
items.kept: Retention depends on how the server is deployed

items.where: Your browser (localStorage), a language code only
items.status: verified in the translation branch; applies once it is merged

items.kept: No safety filter is called in this app (no guardrail code in src/ or api/). The prompt is stored scrubbed only of emails and phone numbers, so names, IP addresses, card numbers and keys typed into a question would be kept for up to 90 days.
items.status: verified by code search of main

items.where: Shown at the top of this page
items.kept: If the safety filter is off, nothing above is masked. The page says so.

controls: Globe app: safety filter masks email, phone and IP before search
Globe app: secrets and card numbers are blocked and never logged
Globe app: fails closed if the safety check cannot run
